summary: A planned clean-room recreation of the Korg monotribe: one VCO, an MS-style filter, an LFO, three drums and an eight-step sequencer. The current build is an early test that only plays a placeholder voice.
features: Early test build: the monotribe instrument itself is not in it yet
Planned: saw, triangle and square VCO, Korg35-style filter, three EG modes
Planned: kick, snare and hi-hat with an eight-step sequencer and flux mode
Planned: the stock monotribe MIDI map over USB, Bluetooth and TRS
No Korg code; browser installer and emulator
